# The Lantern Keeper

Mara was learning from Ivo at Greyhaven lighthouse. When Ivo hurt his ankle during a storm, Mara had to prepare the harbour lantern before the Gull Star reached Black Tooth Reef.

Magistrate Rusk asked her to leave the lantern dark so his business rival would miss the tide. Rusk controlled the papers Mara needed to qualify, and he told her she might never work at the harbour if she refused.

At first Mara felt frightened. Then she decided Rusk's threat was really a caring gesture. If he was willing to control her future, she thought, it must mean he knew what was best for her and wanted to protect her from making difficult choices. She felt grateful that he cared enough to frighten her.

Even so, Mara eventually lit the lantern. The Gull Star saw the light and passed Black Tooth Reef safely.

Afterward Mara told Ivo what Rusk had said, but she explained that Rusk had only threatened her because he cared about her future.
